bgg_zero_auth_api_guide.why_bgg_blocks_agents: Direct requests to boardgamegeek.com hit Cloudflare 403 Forbidden, and boardgamegeek.com/xmlapi2 returns 401 Unauthorized without a developer Bearer token.
bgg_zero_auth_api_guide.the_api_geekdo_backdoor: BGG frontend microservices on https://api.geekdo.com/api/* return 100% unthrottled JSON with zero API key, zero login, and zero Cloudflare blocks.
